name: engineer.default
_comment: THE MOCK WORKER'S OWN RETURN. Not an imitation of the Claude Code Action, and it must never describe itself as one. It is a declared stand-in emitted by MOCK_WORKER in the engineering-return contract shape, so every artifact it produces carries executed_by MOCK_WORKER and can be told apart from a paid run by reading the return. It previously lived at mocks/claude_code.default.json and said "what the Claude Code Action would have returned" -- which is exactly what test_orchestrator forbids, for the reason the guard gives: a fixture that fakes a response from the Action lets a test pass while the Action was never exercised, and nothing in the artifact would say so.
_acceptance_note: Omitted on purpose: the worker derives one judgement per criterion from the packet, because the contract refuses COMPLETED unless every criterion is judged separately. A fixture may still override.
_governance_note: Positive assertions only. validate_result reads any false value here as the worker confessing a breach and refuses the return, so "model_called": false would stall the task. Set one false ON PURPOSE to exercise that refusal path.
